title: Teeth Cleaning
description: Professional dental cleaning to remove plaque and tartar buildup for healthier gums and a brighter smile. Recommended every 6 months.

title: Root Canal
description: Advanced root canal treatment to save infected or decayed teeth. Performed under local anesthesia for a comfortable experience.

title: Dental Implants
description: Permanent titanium post replacements for missing teeth that look, feel, and function like natural teeth.

title: Orthodontics (Braces)
description: Metal, ceramic, and clear aligner options to straighten teeth and correct bite issues for all ages.

title: Cosmetic Dentistry
description: Smile makeovers including veneers, teeth whitening, bonding, and gum contouring for a radiant smile.

title: Pediatric Dentistry
description: Gentle, child-friendly dental care from infancy through adolescence. Preventive treatments and education for healthy habits.

title: Wisdom Tooth Extraction
description: Safe surgical removal of impacted or problematic wisdom teeth with minimal discomfort and fast recovery.

title: Dentures
description: Custom-crafted full and partial dentures that restore function and aesthetics with a natural-looking fit.
